200.description: Human Identity validated and a short-lived continuation grant issued

400.description: Invalid request or device signature encoding

401.description: Device signature or continuation authority rejected

post.description: Starts short-lived client-session establishment for an already enrolled device. The supplied SPKI and optional tenant id are assertions only. The server derives the device fingerprint, resolves the enrolled ACTIVE device and Human Identity, and validates tenant membership before session issuance.

409.description: Active tenant selection required or authority conflict

post.description: Verifies possession of the already enrolled Android P-256 key and, only after current device, membership and tenant authority are revalidated server-side, issues one short-lived opaque client-session bearer credential.

409.description: Challenge consumed or active-tenant authority conflict

get.description: Returns a bounded bootstrap snapshot derived from the authenticated client session and current server-side Human Identity, device, tenant and membership authority. Cached client claims are not authoritative.

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired or revoked client session

200.description: Current authenticated device and tenant location snapshot.

400.description: Invalid, stale or future location observation.

403.description: Current device, membership or tenant authority rejected.

503.description: Client location feature disabled or unavailable.

200.description: Current authenticated device and tenant location snapshot.

403.description: Current device, membership or tenant authority rejected.

404.description: No current location snapshot exists for this device and tenant.

503.description: Client location feature disabled or unavailable.

human_identity_id.description: Opaque Human Identity reference only; not a credential or authority.
Opaque Human Identity reference only; not a credential or authority.

token.description: Sensitive opaque continuation credential; do not log or persist on clients.

continuation_token.description: Sensitive single-use DEVICE_BOOTSTRAP continuation credential; never persist or log.

public_key_spki_b64url.description: Unpadded base64url DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo. Server validates P-256 and derives the fingerprint.

device_signature_b64url.description: ECDSA/SHA-256 signature over the exact server challenge bytes.

initial_tenant_id.description: Server-resolved tenant when unambiguous; null when later active-tenant selection is required.

public_key_spki_b64url.description: Unpadded base64url DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo for the already enrolled P-256 device key. The server derives the fingerprint and resolves device authority; this value is not authority by itself.

requested_tenant_id.description: Optional tenant selection assertion. It grants no authority and must resolve to a current ACTIVE membership.

device_signature_b64url.description: ECDSA/SHA-256 signature over the exact server session challenge bytes.

session_token.description: Sensitive short-lived opaque bearer credential returned once. Never persist raw server-side or log.

ClientLocationPrecision.description: Foreground Android permission precision metadata; observation only, never authority.

ClientSession.description: Short-lived opaque client-session credential scoped server-side to Human Identity, device and active tenant.
